Users don't complain about UI.
They complain about waiting.

That’s why I look beneath the interface—to understand what actually makes users wait.

Data models and systems analysis reveal the rules, states, and relationships behind the UI, so I can design a better way for people and systems to work together—without pushing the system’s burden back onto the user.
